plainText:
Flutter!! Tickets to a New Land (Japanese: ピラピラ！！新天地への切符 Flutter!! Pass to a New Land) is the 31st chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
Oleana shows everyone the Armor and Crown Passes she acquired. Hop notes that the Isle of Armor is where Leon used to train and plays a video of Mustard advertising the Master Dojo. On the other hand, the Crown Tundra is a desolate place with few inhabitants; however, there have been reports of mysterious Pokémon roaming around, so its danger should not be underestimated. Oleana selects and Marvin to go to the Isle of Armor, and Hop, Marnie, and Bede to go to the Crown Tundra. Casey loudly proclaims that she will find Henry for sure.

At the Isle of Armor, Klara and Avery are chasing down a group of who have stolen their uniforms across the Soothing Wetlands. The two bicker with each other, and they reflect on their endeavors. They both want to end their training fast and become Gym Leaders. The Slowpoke return, but instead of holding the uniforms, they hold 's unconscious body. Klara and Avery return to the Master Dojo and tell Mustard about the incident. Klara remembers meeting a poison expert during a tour and decides to call her. Klara calls " " and is given instructions. Meanwhile, Casey and the others all depart and board a train at Wedgehurst to their respective locations. Back at the Master Dojo, Hyde uses the Cram-o-matic 2.0 to make Henry's medicine, and Klara gives it to him. The medicine causes Henry's hair to rapidly grow, but also expels the poison, waking him up. Mustard greets Henry and asks him if he has anyone to contact. Henry is reluctant to contact anyone because of a previous situation, so Mustard tells him that he can join the Master Dojo in the meantime.

Casey and Martin arrive at the Isle of Armor and head towards the Master Dojo, but Klara stops them. She challenges them to a battle, and Casey accepts, much to Martin's chagrin. Casey accidentally sends out all six of her Pokémon, and she starts to cry. Klara believes that Casey is mocking her, and she sends out a Galarian Slowpoke in revenge. Martin notices that Klara's Slowpoke is different than normal and may be a different type. Casey orders to use and easily defeats the Slowpoke. Klara next sends out her , which Casey has never seen before due to it not being present in Galar. Casey sends out her , Bit, and orders it to use , which defeats the Venipede. Klara panics and thinks that if Casey arrives at the dojo, her talent will cause people to forget about Klara. Avery, hiding behind a tree, has similar thoughts. Klara quickly runs off, and Casey runs after her. Henry hears Casey's voice, and he stands up in shock.

==Major events==
and Marvin depart for the Isle of Armor while Hop, Marnie, and Bede depart for the Crown Tundra.
Klara and Avery find and bring him to Mustard.
Klara asks for advice on curing Henry of 's poison and makes a medicine for him.
Casey nicknames her Bit.
